summary: CI only, no router or agent code. security.yml (pip-audit over the runtime and optional requirement sets and both hash locks, lock_requirements.py verify-pypi, govulncheck) gains a weekly schedule trigger (Monday 04:29 UTC); push, pull_request and workflow_dispatch stay, top-level permissions stay contents: read, no secrets, no new actions or tools (pins unchanged, check_pinned_references passes). Traced: a schedule runs the default branch's workflow; threat-review.yml and trusted-security-gate.yml react to workflow_run of CI only, release-provenance.yml to releases, live-memory.yml to dispatch, so a scheduled Security checks run triggers nothing downstream and gives no candidate code any credentials. New test/selftest_dependency_audit.py (added to ci.yml) parses security.yml with yaml.safe_load and rejects a missing or less than weekly schedule, a dropped push or pull_request trigger, a conditional or missing job, and missing or conditional lock/Go audit steps. ADR-0081 records the decision (refines ADR-0045, implements the weekly run ADR-0074 assumes); threat model EN/DE and register TM-16 controls/test_refs name the weekly run. TM-16 stays open; no status was weakened.

findings.evidence: Pre-existing: ADR-0074 states that a CVE in the hash-locked Python sets 'shows in the weekly pip-audit', but security.yml had no schedule trigger and Dependabot alerts are not enabled for the repository; an advisory published after the last push surfaced nowhere until the next commit.
findings.resolution: Weekly schedule on security.yml; test/selftest_dependency_audit.py in CI fails if the schedule or an audit step goes away (run against the previous workflow it fails with exit 1). ADR-0081.

tests.evidence: 10 checks PASS: seven rejected variants (no schedule, monthly, go job skipped on schedule, router lock audit removed, govulncheck removed, lock audits limited to push, pull_request trigger removed), non-mapping rejected, daily accepted, shipped workflow accepted.

tests.command: python test/selftest_dependency_audit.py against security.yml without the schedule (change stashed)
tests.evidence: Counter-check as intended: exit 1, 6 checks FAIL, including 'shipped security.yml runs weekly' with 'no schedule trigger'.

tests.command: All python steps of ci.yml run locally on Windows (70 commands, including the new test)
tests.evidence: 70/70 exit 0. check_public_changes and the PostgreSQL/end-to-end suites are not in this list; see below and limitations.

tests.command: ruff check .; python test/check_adr_index.py; python test/selftest_pinned_references.py && python test/check_pinned_references.py; python test/selftest_threat_review.py; python test/selftest_trusted_gate.py; python test/selftest_control_flow.py && python test/check_control_flow.py; risk-register.json parsed as JSON
tests.evidence: All checks passed; ADR index ok: 81 ADRs; 0 pinning failures/findings; threat review and trusted gate tests ok; control flow ok.
A schedule only fires on the default branch after merge; this PR's push/pull_request run of the same workflow exercises the same jobs.

limitations: The schedule only detects advisories; refreshing the Python locks stays a manual pin/resolve in a PR (TM-16 next action unchanged).
GitHub disables scheduled workflows of a public repository after 60 days without repository activity; the failure notice of a scheduled run goes to the account that last changed the cron line.
Dependabot alerts (a repository setting) were not changed; enabling them is the maintainer's choice and not verifiable from the repository.
The end-to-end suite and the PostgreSQL integrations were not run; no router or agent code changed.
